title: SugarCraft — CandyLayout
description: CandyLayout: Constraint-based layout solver — deterministic greedy 5-phase solver with lossless rounding, plus DockLayout pane geometry for terminal grid layouts.
ogDescription: A ratatui-style constraint solver behind a one-method LayoutSolver interface: GreedySolver handles every constraint type (the deprecated CassowarySolver delegates to it), plus DockLayout pane geometry.
tagline: Constraint-based layout solver for terminal grids
detailMeta: inspired by ratatui/ratatui layout constraint-solver foundation-package
